decision: Piotr owner decision 2026-10-09: Resume T-004 under its existing accepted criteria and add only the lifecycle API obligations needed by T-005. Implement and test: (1) malformed gate rows fail closed; (2) verification admission and task claim form one atomic step under the same lock; (3) a durable same-feature resume path for verification blockages; (4) lifecycle APIs for trusted history metrics and manual-review registration. Derive criteria only from the existing accepted spec and verification contract. Preserve checkpoint 890b48b and do not touch the four untracked root evidence files. Harness review is required before T-005 retries.
prior_reason: Accepted-contract scope gap: independent reviews found repository admission TOCTOU and no durable same-family resume path for verification blockages. The narrow fail-closed result validation is verified, but T-004 cannot safely own or resolve the cross-lock lifecycle changes; preserving this partial work pending a dedicated protocol task.
